_comment: Edit this file (or tell the agent in chat, and copy its answer here) to change what's immovable vs movable. Matching is case-insensitive and checks if the keyword appears anywhere in the event/course title.

weekly_planner._comment: Defaults for plan_week.py, which runs every morning as a rolling 7-day planner (today through +6 days). daily_schedule below holds David's real fixed facts per weekday -- Claude uses these directly when reasoning about each day.

Monday.notes: Gym + sauna morning. Every OTHER Monday: baseball after school until 16:30, lunch at school that day instead.

Wednesday.notes: Gym + sauna morning AND MUN after school -- long day.

Friday.notes: Backup gym day if Mon/Wed morning session got skipped. Work day (see friday_is_work_day below).

Saturday.notes: Backup gym day option. Otherwise flexible/holiday-style day.

weekly_planner.gym_makeup_priority: If a scheduled Mon/Wed morning gym+sauna session gets skipped, first try an afternoon slot that SAME day (Mon or Wed) after school. If that's also not possible, add a lighter/less rigorous makeup session on Friday, then Saturday, then Sunday, in that order of preference.

weekend_planning.notes: Aim for roughly HALF of each weekend day left completely open/unscheduled for friends, parties, and downtime. The other half can hold study, errands, or a gym makeup session.

category_colors._comment: Google Calendar colorId values (1-11), matching real named colors in the Calendar app's own picker.

weekday_block_style.notes: On school days (not weekends, not holidays), fill essentially the ENTIRE day from wake_time to the bedtime target with labeled blocks -- no unlabeled gaps except real transitions (commute, meals already covered by lunch_at_school logic). Every new block's title should start with one of category_labels so the day reads like a fully structured routine, not scattered free time. This does NOT apply on weekends/holidays -- those stay governed by weekend_open_ratio instead.

counselor_meetings.notes: Usually once a week, normally Sunday (sometimes Saturday). These show up as real invites already on Gmail/Calendar -- treat any existing counselor event as immovable like any other calendar event. Don't fill that day's likely counselor slot with something else if no invite exists yet.

sleep_rules._comment: Target is AT LEAST 7 hours before the FOLLOWING day's wake_time. Give a 30-min cushion before that target and 30-min after (for extra work), i.e. an acceptable bedtime window of roughly (wake_time - 7h30m) to (wake_time - 6h30m). On days with an earlier next-day wake time (gym mornings), push bedtime earlier accordingly -- don't schedule heavy activity too close to that window.

spam_filters._comment: Emails matching these (sender or subject, case-insensitive) are ignored entirely -- never queued as 'new email', never shown in the digest. Applies to both school and personal Gmail.
